back_translation: The burden-oracle concerning Moab: For in a single night, Ar of Moab was utterly devastated! For in a single night, Kir of Moab was utterly devastated!
Dibon goes up to its temple, up to the high places, to weep. Moab wails and laments over Nebo and over Medeba. Every head is shaved bald; every beard is shorn off.
Along the streets they wear sackcloth; on the rooftops and in the city squares everyone wails and laments, collapsing in weeping.
Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; their voices are heard as far as Jahaz. Therefore the soldiers of Moab wail aloud; their souls quake with dread.

My heart cries out for Moab; her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath-shelishiyah. They climb the ascent of Luhith weeping as they go; on the road to Horonaim they raise a cry of wailing over the destruction.
For the waters of Nimrim have dried up into desolation; the grass is withered, the green plants are gone, and no greenery remains at all.
Therefore they carry the wealth they have acquired and their belongings across the Brook of the Willows.
For the cry has echoed all around the border of Moab; her wailing reaches Eglaim, and her lamentation reaches Beer-elim.
For the waters of Dimon are full of blood, yet I will bring something heavier still upon Dimon — a lion upon the fugitives of Moab and upon the remnant left in the land.
